[package]
name = "ripgrep"
version = "15.2.0"  #:version
authors = ["Andrew Gallant <jamslam@gmail.com>"]
description = """
ripgrep is a line-oriented search tool that recursively searches the current
directory for a regex pattern while respecting gitignore rules. ripgrep has
first class support on Windows, macOS and Linux.
"""
documentation = "https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep"
repository = "https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep"
keywords = ["regex", "grep", "egrep", "search", "pattern"]
categories = ["command-line-utilities", "text-processing"]
license = "Unlicense OR MIT"
exclude = [
  "HomebrewFormula",
  "/.github/",
  "/ci/",
  "/pkg/brew",
  "/benchsuite/",
  "/scripts/",
  "/crates/fuzz",
]
build = "build.rs"
autotests = false
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true

[[bin]]
bench = false
path = "crates/core/main.rs"
name = "rg"

[[test]]
name = "integration"
path = "tests/tests.rs"

[workspace]
members = [
  "crates/globset",
  "crates/grep",
  "crates/cli",
  "crates/matcher",
  "crates/pcre2",
  "crates/printer",
  "crates/regex",
  "crates/searcher",
  "crates/ignore",
]

[workspace.package]
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.96"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0.75"
bstr = "1.7.0"
grep = { version = "0.4.1", path = "crates/grep" }
ignore = { version = "0.4.29", path = "crates/ignore" }
lexopt = "0.3.0"
log = "0.4.5"
serde_json = "1.0.23"
termcolor = "1.4.0"
textwrap = { version = "0.16.0", default-features = false }

[target.'cfg(all(target_env = "musl", target_pointer_width = "64"))'.dependencies.tikv-jemallocator]
version = "0.7.0"

[dev-dependencies]
serde = "1.0.77"
serde_derive = "1.0.77"
walkdir = "2"

[features]
pcre2 = ["grep/pcre2"]

[profile.release]
debug = 1

[profile.release-lto]
inherits = "release"
opt-level = 3
debug = "none"
strip = "symbols"
debug-assertions = false
overflow-checks = false
lto = "fat"
panic = "abort"
incremental = false
codegen-units = 1

[profile.deb]
inherits = "release-lto"

[package.metadata.deb]
features = ["pcre2"]
section = "utils"
assets = [
  ["target/release/rg", "usr/bin/", "755"],
  ["COPYING", "usr/share/doc/ripgrep/", "644"],
  ["LICENSE-MIT", "usr/share/doc/ripgrep/", "644"],
  ["UNLICENSE", "usr/share/doc/ripgrep/", "644"],
  ["CHANGELOG.md", "usr/share/doc/ripgrep/CHANGELOG", "644"],
  ["README.md", "usr/share/doc/ripgrep/README", "644"],
  ["FAQ.md", "usr/share/doc/ripgrep/FAQ", "644"],
  # The man page is automatically generated by ripgrep's build process, so
  # this file isn't actually committed. Instead, to create a dpkg, either
  # create a deployment/deb directory and copy the man page to it, or use the
  # 'ci/build-deb' script.
  ["deployment/deb/rg.1", "usr/share/man/man1/rg.1", "644"],
  # Similarly for shell completions.
  ["deployment/deb/rg.bash", "usr/share/bash-completion/completions/rg", "644"],
  ["deployment/deb/rg.fish", "usr/share/fish/vendor_completions.d/rg.fish", "644"],
  ["deployment/deb/_rg", "usr/share/zsh/vendor-completions/", "644"],
]
extended-description = """\
ripgrep (rg) recursively searches your current directory for a regex pattern.
By default, ripgrep will respect your .gitignore and automatically skip hidden
files/directories and binary files.
"""

Cargo metadata reads captured manifests with zero-byte source inventory stubs, offline/no-deps/locked; the syntax parser reads captured source text only. Active cfg derives from rustc target cfg plus the declared local feature profile; custom build-script cfg stays unknown.

Call inventory covers parsed function/method bodies plus trait default method bodies, each once per source declaration; declarations without a body add no calls and calls depending on the concrete Self remain unresolved. A local macro_rules! invocation is traversed as its source argument expression only when the binding actually visible at the callsite (including a preceding block-local definition) is defined exactly once across the selected crates, is textually visible without an import or glob that could bind the same name, and every rule matches a single $x:expr used exactly once outside repetition and nested macro arguments under the active cfg; such calls carry macroEvidence. Calls in these templates carry macroTemplate with the captured macro-name definition and distinct invocation/outer-impl origins, retaining printable original self types and optional trait paths. One physical call represents all contributing expansions; directCaller uses a template-qualified macro-generated-method identity, or local-function for a nested function. Divergent targets remain unresolved with rust-context-dependent, retaining provenance but no per-expansion targets. Other macros stay opaque records. directory for a regex pattern while respecting gitignore rules. ripgrep has
first class support on Windows, macOS and Linux.
"""

repository = "https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep"

  "/benchsuite/",
  "/scripts/",
  "/crates/fuzz",
]
build = "build.rs"
autotests = false
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true

[[bin]]
bench = false
path = "crates/core/main.rs"
name = "rg"

[[test]]
name = "integration"
path = "tests/tests.rs"

[workspace]
members = [
  "crates/globset",
  "crates/grep",
  "crates/cli",
  "crates/matcher",
  "crates/pcre2",
  "crates/printer",
  "crates/regex",
  "crates/searcher",
  "crates/ignore",
]

[workspace.package]
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.96"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0.75"
bstr = "1.7.0"
grep = { version = "0.4.1", path = "crates/grep" }
ignore = { version = "0.4.29", path = "crates/ignore" }

[target.'cfg(all(target_env = "musl", target_pointer_width = "64"))'.dependencies.tikv-jemallocator]

walkdir = "2"

[features]

[profile.release]
debug = 1

[profile.release-lto]
inherits = "release"
opt-level = 3

lto = "fat"
panic = "abort"
incremental = false
codegen-units = 1

[package.metadata.deb]
features = ["pcre2"]
section = "utils"
assets = [
  ["target/release/rg", "usr/bin/", "755"],
  ["COPYING", "usr/share/doc/ripgrep/", "644"],
  ["LICENSE-MIT", "usr/share/doc/ripgrep/", "644"],
  ["UNLICENSE", "usr/share/doc/ripgrep/", "644"],
  ["CHANGELOG.md", "usr/share/doc/ripgrep/CHANGELOG", "644"],
  ["README.md", "usr/share/doc/ripgrep/README", "644"],
  ["FAQ.md", "usr/share/doc/ripgrep/FAQ", "644"],

  # this file isn't actually committed. Instead, to create a dpkg, either

  # 'ci/build-deb' script.
  ["deployment/deb/rg.1", "usr/share/man/man1/rg.1", "644"],

  ["deployment/deb/_rg", "usr/share/zsh/vendor-completions/", "644"],
